name: Google Books Add to Shelf
description: Get a Google Books volume, add it to My Library and list the first bookshelf page.
requirements: Google Books API enabled with user authorization for https://www.googleapis.com/auth/books
Open Flow: short-lived OAuth access token in GOOGLE_BOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN Variable; update it when it expires, with no automatic refresh
n8n: managed Google Books OAuth2 credentials retain automatic token refresh
Volume ID and writable My Library bookshelf ID
recommendationReasons: Add a known Google Books volume to a personal shelf and return its first page.
